item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-05 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Identity / Access is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (3). SonicWall has the most new KEV entries this week (2). Seven-day rank movers will appear after a full week of daily snapshots has accumulated.
